official_config_differences: Official CIFAR config uses 5 initial classes and 5-class increments; matched implementation check uses the agreed 10-class split.
Official class shuffle is disabled for the matched implementation check.
Pretrained checkpoint is pinned to the selected AugReg IN21K->IN1K family rather than inferred from an alias.
validation.repeat_policy: Start with matched seed 1993; expand to 3 seeds when differences or uncertainty justify it.
validation.margin_policy: Measure the official reference variability and freeze the acceptable margin before evaluating the port for acceptance. Below-threshold performance blocks merging; high training loss alone is not a sufficient diagnostic.

efficiency.flops: paired diagnostic pass kept separate from measurement

before_any_training: Resolve and record the identical Base checkpoint file/hash for native and official implementations.
Pin reference environment versions and the exact class/sample/transform mapping.
Calibrate and freeze the acceptance margin before examining candidate accuracy.
Validate image forward/backward paths; current checks are metadata, mocks and synthetic feature arithmetic only.
